description: This file defines the RuleChainService interface for managing rule chains within the Thingsboard platform, including methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and associating rule chains and rule nodes.

methods.name: saveRuleChain
methods.description: Saves a rule chain, with optional event publishing and validation.

methods.name: setRootRuleChain
methods.description: Sets a specific rule chain as the root for a tenant.

methods.name: saveRuleChainMetaData
methods.description: Saves metadata for a rule chain, with optional event publishing.

methods.name: loadRuleChainMetaData
methods.description: Loads metadata for a specific rule chain.

methods.name: findRuleChainById
methods.description: Retrieves a rule chain by its ID.

methods.name: findRuleNodeById
methods.description: Finds a rule node by its ID.

methods.name: getRootTenantRuleChain
methods.description: Gets the root rule chain for a tenant.

methods.name: getRuleChainNodes
methods.description: Retrieves all rule nodes within a rule chain.

methods.name: getReferencingRuleChainNodes
methods.description: Gets rule nodes that reference a specific rule chain.

methods.name: getRuleNodeRelations
methods.description: Retrieves relations for a rule node.

methods.name: findTenantRuleChainsByType
methods.description: Finds tenant rule chains filtered by type with pagination.

methods.name: deleteRuleChainById
methods.description: Deletes a rule chain by its ID.

methods.name: exportTenantRuleChains
methods.description: Exports tenant rule chains data.

methods.name: importTenantRuleChains
methods.description: Imports tenant rule chains data.

methods.name: assignRuleChainToEdge
methods.description: Assigns a rule chain to an edge.

methods.name: unassignRuleChainFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns a rule chain from an edge.

methods.name: findRuleChainsByTenantIdAndEdgeId
methods.description: Finds rule chains associated with a tenant and edge.

methods.name: getEdgeTemplateRootRuleChain
methods.description: Gets the edge template root rule chain.

methods.name: setEdgeTemplateRootRuleChain
methods.description: Sets the edge template root rule chain.

methods.name: setAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChain
methods.description: Enables auto-assignment of rule chains to edges.

methods.name: unsetAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChain
methods.description: Disables auto-assignment of rule chains to edges.

methods.name: findAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChainsByTenantId
methods.description: Finds auto-assign rule chains for a tenant.

methods.name: findRuleNodesByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds rule nodes by tenant ID and type.

methods.name: saveRuleNode
methods.description: Saves a rule node.

methods.name: deleteRuleNodes
methods.description: Deletes rule nodes associated with a rule chain.

methods.name: findRuleChainsByIds
methods.description: Finds multiple rule chains by their IDs.
